title: Gentle Dot · native installer directions
brief: Three visual-only macOS and Linux installer concepts: guided first install, trust-first package review, and compact in-app update review. Every state is simulated; no package, network, OS or application operations occur.

artboards.title: Guided · one decision at a time
artboards.tradeoff: Step rail and package overview reduce first-install uncertainty; technical trust details require an extra disclosure or review step.

artboards.title: Trust first · evidence before approval
artboards.tradeoff: An open verification ledger beside a package receipt makes trust boundaries inspectable; increases reading effort before the next action.

artboards.title: Compact · a deliberate update pause
artboards.tradeoff: A centered update sheet and ordered handoff minimize interruption for returning users; deeper preservation and OS-permission details are collapsed.
